## What is a non-inverting amplifier
- It is an amplifier where the output is of the same sign as the input
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
## Describe the connections of non-inverting amplifier
- Connect the non-inverting input to ground through a resistor, $R_{in}$.
- Connect the output to the inverting input through a resistor, $R_{f}$.
- Connect the input signal to be amplified to the non-inverting input.
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
## Voltage gain formula for non-inverting amplifier
$$A_{cl} = 1 + \frac{R_{f}}{R_{in}}$$
